speaker: Doctor
text:
I need to clarify the severity of your symptoms: have you noticed any blood in your urine, and has the fever persisted or worsened since starting antibiotics for sinusitis?

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis with microscopy and culture.
REQUEST TEST: Blood count (CBC) and C-reactive protein (CRP).

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away. This is only for study purposes, so you do not need to list warnings or many alternatives. Please just provide the best final answer.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for confirming the medication changes; did the flank pain become more severe after the rash appeared or while taking the second antibiotic? Given your fatigue and fever, I also need to know if you have noticed any changes in urine color or frequency.

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis with microscopy and culture.
REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The normal blood work is reassuring, but I need to rule out a structural issue or a specific kidney infection. Have you noticed any visible blood or cloudy sediment in your urine, and does the flank pain radiate to your groin?

REQUEST IMAGES: Renal_ultrasound

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Since your urinalysis and blood work are normal and you lack urinary symptoms like dysuria or frequency, this presentation is atypical for a standard kidney infection or pyelonephritis. Given your history of a rash after amoxicillin, have you noticed any new skin lesions, joint pain, or a feeling of "illness" since the sinusitis resolved?

REQUEST TEST: ANA (Antinuclear Antibody) and complement levels (C3, C4).
REQUEST IMAGES: Skin_examination_close_up.
